keyFindings.description: plainInline counts every mark as content, including proofAuthored, which the Dispatch editor (authoredTrackerPlugin, packages/proof-editor/src/lib.ts:330) puts on every character a person types and pmdoc keeps (pmdoc/node.go:45) but Render never writes. So an options edit that drops, renames or clears an option a person typed in the browser is refused, quoting a line that looks plain, and an emptied question that keeps any typed whitespace is refused the repair (refuseEmptyQuestionEdit). No test builds a marked item.

Repairing an emptied decision that holds two bullet lists returns the joined options of every list (parseAskBlock), and editAsk writes them to the ask row (api/asks.go:435-451): the reading readAskBlockStrictly says the row must not take. The row then offers options from a stray list until a person repairs the block.

Rewriting a changed option's description replaces its line with plain text, so a link address, bold, code or image in that line is deleted unseen: the same harm the drop refusal exists to prevent, and the PR body's Outcome claims the link and bold are kept. Tester and architect raised it too.

With two items of one label, first-unused label matching pairs a sent option with the wrong item: a person's sub-list under 'A: x' moves under the rewritten 'A: y' and the plain 'A: y' item is dropped. Match label and description first, then label alone.
The repair step says it keeps the question and first list 'in every decision nested in the blocks it keeps', but askRepairKeepsNothingOfItsOwn deletes some nested decisions whole.
The image-only question refusal names only the document editor, a person's surface; an agent's own path is a new document version (dispatch artifact).
dropUnmatched threads settlement's policy through three signatures; make the merge always drop and refuse the drop as a route-side pre-check.
The writesTheQuestion builder branch is redundant: repairedAskBlockChildren already delegates for under two lists, and a block with two lists never reaches the else arm.

The merged list is parsed on a fresh budget with the caller's text charged to it; charge the caller's new items to the write budget. The comment also carries a test measurement and the BlockBoundary rationale is repeated in six comments.
The file grows from 797 to 1248 lines across four concerns; move the option merge and the repair planner to files of their own.

The empty-question follow is copied between the corpus test and followAskRefusal (1318-1341), with a breaksTheRule flag nesting both delete bodies; sendAskBlockEdit (2351) duplicates sendAskOptions (2806).
The docs and the changelog fragment do not say that settlement's restore drops an unmatched option item whatever it holds, where the route refuses.
